title: The Xteink X4 Pro is a great, tiny e-reader, and it’s cheaper than ever
description: If you’re looking for an e-reader that can easily fit in your pocket (or snap onto your magnet-equipped phone), the tiny Xteink X4 Pro might be worth a look.
